title: Convergence of the Deep Galerkin Method for Finite State Mean Field Control Problems
abstract: arXiv:2405.13346v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We establish the convergence of the deep Galerkin method (DGM), a deep learning-based scheme for solving high-dimensional nonlinear PDEs, for Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equations that arise from the study of mean field control problems (MFCPs). Based on a recent characterization of the value function of the MFCP as the unique viscosity solution of an HJB equation on the simplex, we establish both an existence and convergence result for the DGM. First, we show that the loss functional of the DGM can be made arbitrarily small given that the value function of the MFCP possesses sufficient regularity. Then, we show that if the loss functional of the DGM converges to zero, the corresponding neural network approximators must converge uniformly to the true value function on the simplex. We also provide numerical experiments demonstrating the DGM's ability to generalize to high-dimensional HJB equations.

translated_title: 有限状态均值场控制问题的深度Galerkin方法的收敛性
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2405.13346v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：我们建立了深度Galerkin方法（DGM）的收敛性，这是一种基于深度学习的高维非线性偏微分方程求解方案，适用于由均值场控制问题（MFCPs）研究产生的Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman（HJB）方程。基于MFCP值函数在单纯形上作为HJB方程唯一粘性解的最新表征，我们为DGM建立了存在性和收敛性结果。首先，我们表明，在MFCP值函数具有足够正则性的条件下，DGM的损失泛函可以任意小。然后，我们表明，如果DGM的损失泛函收敛到零，相应的神经网络逼近器必须在单纯形上一致收敛到真实值函数。我们还提供了数值实验，展示了DGM在高维HJB方程上的泛化能力。
tldr: 该论文证明了深度Galerkin方法在求解均值场控制问题对应的HJB方程时，其损失函数可任意小且网络逼近器能一致收敛到真实值函数，并验证了高维泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the deep Galerkin method converges for HJB equations from mean field control problems, with loss arbitrarily small and neural network approximators uniformly converging to the true value function, demonstrating high-dimensional generalization.
